title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence:
Diff adds exactly two automated pins (client_test.gleam:5235 "pub fn status_stepper_rail_can_shrink_inside_card_test()" and :5247 "pub fn status_stepper_terminal_roots_fill_card_test()"). findings.md POST-REVIEW concedes the third claimed pin is not a test: "Tests: +3 pins (rail min-w-0, terminal roots w-full, comparison wrap via
browser verify). 1527 passed." Traceability over the 26 code hunks: P0 0 units (none in diff) = 100%; P1 (B1, 6 hunks) 3/6 = 50%; P2 (T1, 3 hunks) 0/3 = 0%; P3 (17 hunks: T2 x5, T3 x1, T4 x6, T5 x1, T6 x1, T7 x2, N1 x1) 0/17 = 0%; overall 3/26 ≈ 12%.
detail: Gate FAIL: P1 coverage 50% (<80% threshold) and overall ~12% (<80%). The PR's headline functional fix is half-pinned and its P2 layout companion is pinned only by an unrepeatable manual browser check.
recommended_fix: Extend the terminal-roots test to AutoClosed; pin the application_detail wrapper w-full; add comparison_bar flex-wrap/min-h pin; add min-h-[44px] pins to the handoff/distribution/save-draft tests. That lifts P1 to 100% and overall above 60%.
